_docs: Hype phrase library. 'category' mirrors campaign tones: bullish | community | fomo | momentum | lore | hold. Add your own lines, run /reseed in Telegram, done. Use $TICKER and it will be replaced with your token's ticker.

phrases.text: 🟢 $TICKER is waking up. The ones who noticed are already here.
🟢 Being early is a strategy, not an accident. Those who act are the rare ones.
🟢 The chart is quiet. The on-chain data is not. $TICKER
🟢 Quiet phases build loud stories. Every legend starts in silence.
🟢 Nobody remembers those who waited. Everybody remembers those who moved.
🟢 Conviction is cheap right now. It won't be later. That's the whole point.
🚀 One meme. One community. One mission. And you're already in.
🚀 Everyone wants to find the next great community early. You're reading this — that's what early looks like.
🚀 The community grows every day. The question isn't if. It's whether you're in before they are.
🚀 Strong communities aren't built overnight. That's exactly why they can't be copied.
🚀 Memes fade. Communities compound. The people here now are the compounding.
🚀 The loudest voices of every cycle started as silent members of a community like this one.
👀 Most people discover the next meme after it moves. Reading this is your window.
👀 They'll call it luck when they find out later. You'll remember this moment.
👀 The best time to pay attention was yesterday. Every hour you wait, the gap grows.
👀 Some stories you watch. Others you live. Only one of them has an entry price.
👀 Windows like this don't reopen. They get remembered.
👀 The cost of being early is patience. The cost of being late is everything.
⚡ Early communities write the story. Everyone else pays to read it later.
⚡ The on-chain numbers are moving. The timeline hasn't noticed yet. It will.
⚡ Momentum favors those who arrived before the noise. The noise is coming.
⚡ The energy is growing. You can still feel it before everyone else.
⚡ Every big move starts with a small group that refuses to look away. This is that group.
🧠 Long before the chart, there was the story. You're here for the story.
🧠 Every great meme has an origin story. The ones reading this are in ours.
🧠 Legends aren't discovered later. They're built by the ones who stayed.
💎 Diamonds are just carbon that stayed patient under pressure. So is conviction.
💎 Weak hands trade stories. Strong hands write them — and keep them.
💎 Patience is the rarest meme of all. That's why it pays the most.
💎 Selling early doesn't lock in a win. It locks in a story you'll tell with regret.
💎 Every seller needs a buyer with more conviction. Be the buyer they needed.
